data.summary: Wrote intent/r20b/tech-spec.md specifying the dots-left HUD counter. The count reuses the existing GameState.dotsRemaining, set from countRemaining(createMaze()) and lowered by eatDot. The spec adds an exported dotsText helper in render.ts, a #dots span in index.html between #lives and #best, and a render() wire-up in main.ts. It lists unit tests in game.test.ts, an e2e check, and canon follow-up for CAP-4. Assumption: "dots" includes pellets, matching the checkWin rule; no open questions.
